card.name: Word parts just before a G
card.fires_on: Partway through a longer word or name when the next piece is expected to start with G, such as Hypoxanthine-Guanine, PEGINTRON, INVEGA, UGT, Pittsburgh or SAGD.

modes.label: Inside drug and compound names
modes.description: Mid-name pieces right before a G piece in brand or chemical names.

modes.label: Other names and phrases before G
modes.description: Pieces of place names or titles where G comes next, such as Pittsburgh or Global.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens starting with G, so it seems to act as a brake on a G coming next.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long name when a G-starting piece is about to follow.
